purpose: Three standalone legacy PHP utility classes for customer records, content pages and social feed operations; not a full application.
stack: Legacy PHP, object-oriented classes, direct SQL database calls
subtitle: Reusable PHP helpers for records, pages and social content.
summary: Compact legacy PHP classes for customer information, content management and social wall or friend-feed operations.
overview: This repository holds three root-level PHP classes rather than a deployed application. Source evidence covers customer records, page/section content operations and social wall helpers. Direct SQL queries require input validation and SQL-injection safety review before any reuse.
focus: A developer utility project—not a launched SaaS, current framework package, security-reviewed system or standalone mobile API.
